versions.content: Package structure of the VSMD The package structure of the VSMD has to be different than "/AUTOSAR/EcucDefs/" so that it is pos- sible to distinguish the standardized from the vendor specific module definitions. Example 4.4 shows the difference between the VSMD and StMD. The package structure of the vendor specific CanIf module definition begins with "/VendorX/- CanIf" and the package structure of the vendor specific CanDrv module definition begins with "/VendorY/Can".
